Legal

Affiliate Disclosure

Last updated: 1 November 2026

Plain-English summary: some links on this site may earn us a commission if you buy through them. It never costs you extra and it does not change what we write.

Current status

GlowHer Skincare is a new project. At the time of writing, our product pages are sample listings, and we have no active affiliate relationships. Buttons that will link to retailers are clearly marked as placeholders. We do not claim any official partnership with any brand or retailer.

How affiliate links will work

  • When we join an affiliate programme, links to that retailer may earn us a small commission on qualifying purchases.
  • Affiliate links are marked with rel="sponsored" and carry a visible note next to the button.
  • The price you pay is the same whether you use our link or not.

Editorial independence

We choose topics and products based on usefulness to readers. Commissions, brand relationships and free samples (if we ever receive any) will not decide what we say, and any such relationship will be disclosed.

Where this applies

We aim to follow the endorsement and advertising rules that apply to our readers, including the US Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Endorsement Guides, the UK Advertising Standards Authority (ASA) and Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) guidance, the Canadian Competition Bureau's guidance on online endorsements, and the EU Unfair Commercial Practices framework.

Retailer programme statements

Some programmes (for example, Amazon Associates) require specific wording. Where we join a programme that requires a statement, we will add it here and in the footer.

Prices and availability

Product details, prices and availability change. Always confirm on the retailer's page before you buy.

Health information

Our content is for general education and is not medical advice. Always read product labels and consult a healthcare professional about skin conditions.

Questions

Email hello@glowher.example or use the contact page.
